items.title: iii. Anomalous heat of vaporization and boiling point (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: iii. Anomalous heat of vaporization and boiling point: a main subheading of 5.4.4 Influence of hydrogen bonding on the properties of water, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 102-103.

blocks.text: Group 16 ke hydrides mein enthalpy change of vaporization (liquid ko vapour banane ki heat) aam taur par H₂S se H₂Po tak barhti jati hai (Figure 5.7), kyunke in molecules ko kamzor London dispersion forces jore rakhti hain.

blocks.alt: H2O, H2S, H2Se, H2Te aur H2Po ke liye element ke atomic number ke against do line graphs, saath saath. Baen graph, enthalpy of vaporization (10 se 50 kJ/mol): H2O taqreeban 41, H2S par gir kar taqreeban 18, phir H2Se taqreeban 20 aur H2Te taqreeban 24 se H2Po taqreeban 38 tak. Daen graph, boiling point (-90 se 110 degrees C): H2O 100, H2S taqreeban -60, H2Se taqreeban -41, H2Te taqreeban -2, H2Po taqreeban 35.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.7: Group 16 hydrides ki enthalpy of vaporization aur boiling points ka graph (kitab ki Figure 5.7 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph mein H₂S se H₂Po tak line upar jati hai, kyunke molecule bara hone se London forces barhti hain. Is hisab se H₂O sab se neeche hona chahiye tha, magar woh sab se upar hai (100 °C aur taqreeban 41 kJ mol⁻¹). Wajah pani ke molecules ke darmiyan mazboot hydrogen bonds hain. Kitab ke pehle graph ke title mein ‘of 16 hydrides’ chhapa hai; sahi ‘group 16 hydrides’ hai.

Group mein neeche S se Po tak atomic size barhta hai, is liye van der Waals forces bhi mazboot hoti jati hain. Agar pani isi trend par chalta to us ki heat of vaporization group mein sab se kam hoti. Lekin pani ki enthalpy change of vaporization group mein sab se zyada hai (41 kJ mol⁻¹). Wajah: pani bohat zyada hydrogen bonded hai, is liye us ke molecules ke darmiyan forces torna aur use vapour banana mushkil hai. Pani ka boiling point bhi group 16 ke baqi hydrides se kahin zyada hai: molecules ko alag karne ke liye bohat energy chahiye, aur itni energy dene ke liye ooncha temperature chahiye.
